results.content: # How Generative AI Endangers Cultural Narratives Failing to take the cultural aspects of generative AI seriously is likely to result in the streamlining of human expression into the patterns of the largely American content that these systems are trained on. As generative AI is integrated into everyday tools such as word processors and search engines, it’s time to think about what kinds of stories it can generate—and what stories it will *not* generate. This story is more than a shared cultural reference—it supports the Norwegian criminal justice system’s priority of rehabilitation over punishment. Generative AI might well bury stories like Cardamom Town by stuffing chatbot responses and search results worldwide with homogenized American narratives.
